name: Khârn the Betrayer
oracle_text:
Berzerker — Khârn the Betrayer attacks or blocks each combat if able.
Sigil of Corruption — When you lose control of Khârn the Betrayer, draw two cards.
The Betrayer — If damage would be dealt to Khârn the Betrayer, prevent that damage and an opponent of your choice gains control of it.
blocked_sentences: Berzerker — Khârn the Betrayer attacks or blocks each combat if able.
Sigil of Corruption — When you lose control of Khârn the Betrayer, draw two cards.
The Betrayer — If damage would be dealt to Khârn the Betrayer, prevent that damage and an opponent of your choice gains control of it.

needs.what: a self trigger 'when you lose control of this permanent' that fires for the former controller when the permanent's controller changes (the engine already logs a control_changed event), with the ability controlled by the player who lost it so 'draw two cards' draws for them
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has leaves_battlefield and dies but nothing keyed on control_changed; a control change is not a zone change, so no listed event observes it

needs.what: a static replacement on the permanent itself: if damage would be dealt to it, prevent that damage and then run effects (here gain_control by an opponent chosen by the current controller, duration permanent), applied each time damage would be dealt
needs.why_existing_wont_do: the prevent_damage static and prevent_damage_permanent op exist, but no listed static carries follow-up effects on prevention; a damage_prevented trigger would use the stack rather than happening as part of the replacement, and the chooser ('an opponent of your choice') must be the controller at that time

needs.what: a static requirement 'attacks or blocks each combat if able': on its controller's turn it must attack if able, on an opponent's turn it must block if able
needs.why_existing_wont_do: attacks_if_able covers only the attack half; there is no blocks-if-able static in static_effects (must_block is a one-shot op)
